title: Oracle Evening Brief

**ORACLE EVENING BRIEF**

Bitcoin capitulation is clearing weak hands at exactly the right moment. Price sits at $62,750, down half a percent, but here's what matters: the Fed's rate-hiking cycle is exhausted. That removes the last brake on Bitcoin demand.

Hashrate holding firm at 898 EH/s while price compresses tells you miners see what's coming. Long-term holders are pulling supply off exchanges into cold storage—that's accumulation disguised as fear.
